more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
EU food labels require the specified warning about possible effects on children's activity and attention under the 2026 consolidated rules.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Allura Red AC is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include dried fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetables in vinegar oil or brine, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, fruit and vegetable preparations excluding compote. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: The dye is made by coupling two prepared aromatic chemical intermediates. It is a synthetic ingredient.
more_info.side_effects:
At food-use levels, the 2009 EFSA review found most refined exposure estimates below its intake limit. Mixture studies in children cannot identify the effect of this dye alone.
At high intake, some estimates for young children slightly exceeded the limit; this is an exposure assessment, not proof of harm.
